entities.name: Duskmourn
entities.description: A horror-inspired plane swallowed by an endless, living haunted mansion called the House; introduced in Duskmourn: House of Horror.

entities.name: The House
entities.description: A once-ordinary dwelling owned by the Vendrell family that now spans the whole plane as a living entity thriving on fear.

entities.name: Valgavoth
entities.description: A demon once summoned and imprisoned in the House's basement who expanded the House to swallow the plane and feeds on fear; his symbol is the moth.

entities.name: The Ascension
entities.description: The period of chaos in which Valgavoth expanded the House and swallowed the entire plane.

entities.name: Harrowings
entities.description: Surges of malevolence occurring whenever Valgavoth molts into a new body, lasting a few days.

entities.name: Quiescences
entities.description: Weeks-long lulls before Valgavoth molts, the closest the House comes to safety.

entities.name: Cult of Valgavoth
entities.description: A cabal of worshippers led by the seneschal Victor who believe Valgavoth's fear-eating is a blessing and perform the Rite of the Threshold.

entities.name: Victor
entities.description: The seneschal who leads the Cult of Valgavoth and is the only one who communicates directly with Valgavoth.

entities.name: Razorkin
entities.description: Former survivors who hunt the remaining survivors for amusement and mostly obey the Lord of Pain.

entities.name: House Institute
entities.description: A survivor group investigating the House's supernatural events to find a way to end it.

entities.name: Benefactors
entities.description: Nomadic survivors who know the House's geography and mark safe zones with a flame symbol.

entities.name: Doorblades
entities.description: A small band of ruthless survivors who assassinate monsters and collaborate with the House Institute.

entities.name: Rotrue Wood
entities.description: An elven forest ruled by a king, the last location on the plane consumed by the House.

entities.name: The Below
entities.description: A lightless underground chamber where Valgavoth resides, the only fixed point in the plane.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: The invasion during which the Phyrexians failed to enter the House.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: The invaders who failed to enter the House.

entities.name: Omenpaths
entities.description: Portals whose opening made it much easier for Valgavoth to open doors to other planes and bring in victims.

entities.name: Nashi
entities.description: A person who went through a door into Duskmourn and whom friends traveled there to retrieve.

entities.name: Kaito Shizuki
entities.description: A planeswalker who traveled to Duskmourn to retrieve Nashi.

entities.name: Niko Aris
entities.description: A member of the party who traveled to Duskmourn.

entities.name: Tyvar Kell
entities.description: A member of the party who traveled to Duskmourn.

entities.name: Zimone Wola
entities.description: A member of the party who traveled to Duskmourn.

entities.name: The Wanderer
entities.description: A member of the party who traveled to Duskmourn.

entities.name: Vendrell family
entities.description: The family who purchased the House before it expanded.

entities.name: Beasties
entities.description: The plane's former pets that transformed during Valgavoth's ascension.

entities.name: Wickerfolk
entities.description: Living wood constructs that used to be humans and other survivors.

entities.name: Lord of Pain
entities.description: The figure whose directives most razorkin listen to.

events.summary: Valgavoth, imprisoned in a house, expands its barriers and swallows the entire plane in the Ascension, folding the demon realm into the physical realm.
events.quote: expanded the barriers of the House and swallowed the entire plane in a period of chaos known as the Ascension

events.summary: The Rotrue Wood is the last wilderness to fall to the House.
events.quote: The Rotrue Wood was the last to fall.

events.summary: The House begins to prey on citizens' fears, and a twisted symbiosis with its victims develops.
events.quote: As the house began to expand, it started to prey on its citizens and their fears.

events.summary: During the New Phyrexian Invasion the Phyrexians fail to enter the House, possibly blocked by Valgavoth.
events.quote: During the New Phyrexian Invasion , the Phyrexians failed to enter the House.

events.summary: In the Omenpath Era, doors to other planes become easier for Valgavoth to open, and the House shifts from farming to hunting.
events.quote: It can now hunt rather than farm, and the safe zones are rapidly decreasing.

events.summary: After Nashi goes through a door, Kaito, Niko, Tyvar, Zimone and the Wanderer travel to Duskmourn to retrieve him.
events.quote: After Nashi went through one of these doors, Kaito Shizuki , Niko Aris , Tyvar Kell , Zimone Wola , and the Wanderer traveled to the plane to retrieve him.

events.summary: The carnival grounds safe zone is lost to City's razorkin and Wickerfolk around 4564 AR.
events.quote: It was lost to City 's razorkin and Wickerfolk around 4564 AR .

events.summary: Razorkin recreate the Meathook Massacre after its story reaches Duskmourn from Innistrad.
events.quote: the razorkin were inspired to recreate it, creating the Meathook Massacre II .
